messages:
alex: heads up — deploybot halted image publish for service payments. ECR returned ambiguous tag mapping for 'latest-rc' (two digests). Need decision: pin to digest, rollback, or manual unblock?

deploybot: deploybot: publish_hold detected. repo=redwood/payments, tag=latest-rc, digests=[sha256:aaa111def, sha256:bbb222xyz], reason=tag-ttl-expiry-retag. action=hold until manual_approve.

jamal: is this from the lifecycle policy TTL job? I saw prune activity around 01:02 UTC in registry logs.

lucy: yup — lifecycle ran and removed an orphaned tag which caused a previous ephemeral push to inherit the tag. Suggestion: pin service image to the intended digest and continue canary. Also update release notes with the pinned digest.

sophia: quick Q — does this force us to re-run cosign attestation? our provenance references tag metadata in CI.

jamal: cosign verifies by digest; the attestation we store has tag metadata in the manifest annotations. Safe flow: pin -> regenerate attestation for that digest (cheap) -> resume. We should avoid resubmitting a full rebuild. @alex fyi.

alex: we are inside the change window until 03:00 UTC. Proposal: pin payments:v1.12.3@sha256:aaa111def, regenerate attestation, add note to release notes, then resume publish. If attestation regen can't finish by 02:30 UTC, rollback to previous canary sha256:ccc333old and hold.

lucy: commands I ran to inspect the repo:
```
# check images
aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name redwood/payments --image-ids imageTag=latest-rc
# output showed two imageManifest entries with different imageDigest values
```

lucy: also pulled lifecycle logs: "lifecycle rule 5 triggered prune on 2026-03-21T01:02:12Z, removed tag 'ephemeral-20260321' and shuffled tag pointer"

deploybot: deploybot: provisional_action_set = [hold_until_manual_approve]. runbook: https://go.redwood/release/runbook-ecr-tag-collisions. approved_actions = [pin_digest, regen_attestation, resume_publish].

jamal: :thumbsup: I'll pin and regen attestation now. tagging to sha256:aaa111def and kicking attestation job. Will post digest + attestation URL when done.

jamal: jamal: pinned payments:v1.12.3@sha256:aaa111def; attestation uploaded -> https://s3.redwood/attestations/payments/sha256-aaa111def.json. ready for approve_publish.

alex: alex: confirmed attestation + digest. flipping approve_publish. release notes updated: 'payments: pinned image to sha256:aaa111def due to ECR tag TTL collision; cosign attestation regenerated.'

deploybot: deploybot: publish resumed. canary deploy initiated. canary logs: 12:34:56 service up, 12:35:10 health checks pass. publish complete for canary stage. monitoring watching for regressions.

lucy: leaving hold-note in the changelog and scheduling a follow-up postmortem to adjust lifecycle rule to avoid tag reshuffling during active release windows.
